text: Intensification: Simple Example (TSP) Context @ Problem: Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) @ Solution representation: a tour (permutation of cities) @ Move: 2-opt edge exchange Observation from recency memory @ In the last many iterations, edges (A, B) and (C, D) appear unchanged in the best solutions Intensification step @ Freeze persistent components: edges (A, B) and (C, D) are held fixed @ Local search around the best solution: apply 2-opt moves only on the remaining edges Effect @ Search space is reduced @ Trusted structure is preserved @ Remaining parts of the tour are refined more aggressively
